about: The map's stage table (dev/requirements/study-stages-map.md, The stages), the rows a control of the page follows, transcribed: per action its row's label, its five cells word for word, and whether the page opens it in that stage (`open`). test_stage_table.py holds each cell to the map's table and each `open` to web/stages.js; test_stage_table_page.py loads the stand-in study in each stage and holds the page's controls to it. `control` says where the control is: main (the study's page) or setup (Study Setup), its selector and, where it shows only once an image is open (`after`), that; null for an action with no control of its own.

setup-data.row: Study Setup (root write): folders, tags, descriptions, areas of interest, damaged areas, Needs GT, hide rules, GT setup, previews
cells: open: new images may still be added and marked

view.row: Main app, view and run the algorithm on the study's images

own-images.row: Run the algorithm on your own images, in the browser only, nothing leaving the device

annotate.row: Start Annotating, saving extractions (extractions folder write)
cells: open: annotations replace the algorithm's answer in the study's numbers

mark.row: Mark an extraction GT or official (Study Setup, study owner)

batch.row: Batch run (Study Setup) over chosen images
cells: open once there is an algorithm
